items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Paul Barber and then he were talking about what that, I just remember.

ctx.x: Well, I'd like to meet him then, because that's the only other guy I've ever heard of that heard of Paul Tremaine, and yet I can tell you that band was...
Yeah, I've heard of him. Paul Barber and then he were talking about what that, I just remember. About Paul Tremaine's band? About Tremaine's band. Then I'd like to ask Barber about it.

Yeah, well I remember that was a very popular band. I know they were in Young's Chinese American restaurant in New York for years, and they must have come previously from someplace called Only Acres, maybe a dance hall or something, you know, they did that off, like the Casa Loma Band came out of a Casa Loma restaurant. And I understood later on that the guys were working there for about seventeen dollars a week and found a room and board, which was not uncommon for bands in those days, you used to work for very…
